title: Cuscuz recheado
creator: alessandracrivellaro
steps: Mix the flocão with the salt and water and leave it to hydrate for at least 45 minutes. The longer it rests, the fluffier it gets.
Grease a mug or small bowl. Add half the flocão, then the requeijão and the mozzarella, and cover with the rest. Don't press it down.
Microwave for 1:30, check, and continue up to 2–3 minutes in total depending on your microwave's power.
Turn it out onto a plate and serve.
notes: The creator says this version has under 300 kcal.
